_comment: SAMPLE ONLY. Real flights are provided at runtime via the FLIGHTS_JSON secret (cloud) or a local flights.json (dev). Copy this to flights.json and edit for local use.
_times: sched_departure_local is the clock time at the DEPARTURE airport and sched_arrival_local the clock time at the ARRIVAL airport — never your own timezone. Getting this wrong shifts every alert by the offset and looks perfectly plausible; the bot cross-checks against the airline schedule and corrects itself, but it can only do that once it can reach the flight.
